scripts.text: SELECT TOP 1 SOURCE FROM [APP_CPMA].[CPM_WB_SOURCES] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DESCRIPTION='CM Initial Outreach Note'

UPDATE MHC SET MHC.UPDATE_DATE=GETDATE()
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS_STAGE]) IOS
  INNER JOIN [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS] MHC ON IOS.SUBSCRIBER_ID=MHC.SUBSCRIBER_ID
  WHERE STATUS IS NULL

UPDATE [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS]  SET STATUS ='C' FROM
  (
    SELECT 
CID,COUNT(TIMEADD) ATTEMPTCOUNT,TIMEADD FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS]
WHERE STATUS IS NULL
GROUP BY TIMEADD,CID HAVING COUNT(TIMEADD)=3
  ) CALLATTEMPTS WHERE [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS].TIMEADD = CALLATTEMPTS.TIMEADD
AND [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS].CID = CALLATTEMPTS.CID



;WITH PURGE AS  (
SELECT CID,TIMEADD,UPDATE_DATE,COUNT(UPDATE_DATE) ATTEMPTCOUNT FROM  [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS]
WHERE STATUS='C' AND DATEDIFF(DD,UPDATE_DATE,GETDATE())>5
GROUP BY CID,TIMEADD,UPDATE_DATE
HAVING COUNT(UPDATE_DATE)=3
 )
DELETE MHC FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS] MHC
JOIN PURGE P ON MHC.CID=P.CID AND MHC.TIMEADD=P.TIMEADD AND MHC.UPDATE_DATE=P.UPDATE_DATE
